text: Bitcoin's 4% pullback to $71.5k and Ethereum's softer 3% decline suggest a measured correction rather than panic selling, with altcoins tracking slightly worse. Fear & Greed at 28 indicates genuine caution has set in over the past week, though the $71B in daily volume remains substantial enough to absorb moves without capitulation. Bitcoin dominance at 59.5% reflects money rotating cautiously toward the largest asset, a typical defensive posture when sentiment weakens.
